questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to join safely.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to join safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: When preparing to turn left from a two-way street, drive:

options.text: Near the right side of the road.
Near the center line.
Left of the center line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the center line.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street, stay in the lane closest to the center line. Turn just before your car reaches the middle of the intersection. Do not cut the corner. Turn into the first available legal lane.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use your left foot to brake.
Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
Always brake hard to ensure you stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating.
questions.explanation: Use your right foot for both braking and accelerating. Brake gently with increasing pressure so your vehicle stops smoothly.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, it is safe to return to your lane when:

options.text: You cannot see the vehicle to your right.
You see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
You have passed the other vehicle's front bumper.

questions.correctAnswerText: You see the vehicle's headlights in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before moving back to your lane after passing, make sure you are not too close to the other vehicle. When you can see both headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to return safely.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on water instead of the road. To prevent it in wet weather:

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Slow down.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it rains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Slow down when driving on wet pavement to prevent hydroplaning.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, it is safe to move back to the right lane when:

options.text: About three seconds have passed.
You can no longer see the passed vehicle over your right shoulder.
You can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Do not return to your lane until you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Always check your blind spots before moving back.

questions.question: Speeding too much:

options.text: Saves time and gets you there faster.
Helps you avoid obstacles.
Increases the risk of serious injury and death.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of serious injury and death.
questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of crashes. It does not save time and leads to dangerous decisions.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
At the legal speed limit.
Slower than freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Enter a freeway at or near the speed of traffic, unless traffic is above the legal speed limit.

questions.question: A steady yellow light means the light will turn red soon. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you should:

options.text: Stop.
Keep going and clear the intersection safely.
Speed up to avoid an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep going and clear the intersection safely.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, clear the intersection as quickly as you can.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A yield sign is ahead.
A side road enters from the left.
A stop sign is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A yield sign is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in residential areas if no other sign is posted?

options.text: 25 mph
30 mph
20 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 25 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit in residential areas is 25 mph unless a different speed is posted. Watch carefully for children near schools, playgrounds, and in neighborhoods. Always drive slowly and carefully where children may be present.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Pump the brake pedal quickly several times
Slow down gradually without using the brakes
Press the brake pedal down as hard as possible

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually without using the brakes
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Remove your foot from the gas pedal and do not brake hard. Let the car slow down on its own. Use the brakes gently only if needed. Move off the road safely as soon as possible.

questions.question: Which of these is not safe on an interstate?

options.text: Slower traffic stays in the right lane
Change lanes without signaling
If you miss your exit, go to the next one

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes without signaling
questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes. On an interstate, stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic. You cannot back up or make a U-turn on an interstate. If you miss your exit, drive to the next one.

questions.question: What is a driving distraction?

options.text: Anything that makes you swerve while driving
Anything that takes your attention away from driving
Anything that makes you focus more on driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Anything that takes your attention away from driving
questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your mind off driving. Distractions can happen anywhere and at any time. Distracted driving causes crashes, which can damage property, injure people, and cause death.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn ahead
A road joins from the right
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: How do you know where traffic is behind you?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror often
Turn and look out your back window
Keep other vehicles out of your blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your rearview mirror often
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirror regularly to see the traffic behind you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead
The road curves left, then right
The road curves right, then left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and drive safely through the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle has the right-of-way
Slow-moving vehicle
Shoulder work ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down or stop
Stop if necessary
You must come to a complete stop

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see traffic coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: General warning signs
Construction and maintenance warning signs
Regulatory signs

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction and maintenance warning signs
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: How should you yield to an emergency vehicle using its siren and flashing lights?

options.text: Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
Move into the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Stop immediately, even if you are in an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right edge of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. Drive to the right edge of the road and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. You can move again after the vehicle passes.

questions.question: When is a U-turn not permitted?

options.text: In a parking lot.
On or near any curve or hill.
On a straight road with clear visibility for 500 feet in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near any curve or hill.
questions.explanation: Never turn around on or near curves or hills. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians and may cause a crash.

questions.question: What is the law about alcohol in a motor vehicle on a highway?

options.text: It is illegal to drink from or have open containers of alcohol.
It is legal to drink alcohol if you are not the driver.
It is legal to drink alcohol if you are driving but not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is illegal to drink from or have open containers of alcohol.
questions.explanation: Drivers cannot drink alcohol or drive under its influence. Passengers also cannot have open alcohol containers in a moving vehicle.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the center of a road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed only from your direction.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double yellow lines mean no one can cross the center line to pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What speed should you drive when merging onto a freeway?

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
Five to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.
The posted speed limit for the freeway.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging onto a freeway, match the speed of traffic on the freeway.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line in the center of a road mean?

options.text: A construction zone is ahead.
Passing is not permitted from either direction.
Passing is permitted from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is permitted from either direction.
questions.explanation: Broken yellow lines on a two-lane road mean any driver can pass when the other lane is clear of oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line between two lanes of traffic mean?

options.text: Both lanes of traffic move in the same direction.
Passing is allowed when it is safe.
Passing is not allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Dashed yellow lines separate lanes with traffic moving in opposite directions. You can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Pedestrian crossing ahead.
Pedestrians must not cross here.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop and wait until pedestrians cross the marked crosswalk.

questions.question: When roads are slippery from rain, what should you do?

options.text: Avoid fast turns and stops.
Test your tires' grip while driving uphill.
Look closer to your vehicle instead of ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid fast turns and stops.
questions.explanation: Wet roads reduce tire grip, so drive slower than on dry roads. Fast turns or stops can cause your vehicle to skid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrian crossing.
School crossing.
Jogging trail.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.
